app/src/document.js:14 — stylesheet href only resolves via undocumented build-time head-asset extraction (dist/server/entrypoint.js routeAssets)
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name].js:287 (+404.js:14, moves/[name].js:60, abilities/[name].js:58, types/[name].js:84) — not-found fallback markup duplicated across 5 routes
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name].js:219-262 — untyped props object handed from handler to template; no JSDoc or TS at the boundary
app/src/routes/(home).js:99 — 500 fallback returns empty-state UI, conflating server error with 'no matches'
churn_resistance.rationale: Data access, components and config are well centralized, and all framework-facing code matches the official starter so a minor upgrade touches nothing. But the build-time guard is duplicated six times against a private env contract, the not-found template is copy-pasted five times, the handler→template contract is untyped, and one asset-link idiom couples the app to undocumented build behavior.

findings.issue: Stylesheet href (new URL('./document.css', import.meta.url).pathname) never resolves to a servable URL at runtime; it only works because Gracile extracts <link>s at build time into routeAssets
findings.suggestion: Use the documented source-relative href (e.g. href="/src/document.css") that Vite serves in dev and rewrites at build, or import the CSS through the framework's documented asset path

findings.issue: BUILDING() guard duplicated in 6 route files and coupled to a custom GRACILE_BUILD=1 env contract with the build script in package.json
findings.suggestion: Extract one shared isBuildTime() helper in src/lib and reference it from routes; keep the env contract in a single place

findings.issue: No types at the handler→template boundary (plain JS, zero type annotations or JSDoc); prop renames break templates silently
findings.suggestion: Add TypeScript or at least JSDoc typedefs for route props; the framework is TS-first and defineRoute infers from them

findings.issue: Not-found fallback template duplicated across 5 route files (404.js, pokemon, moves, abilities, types/[name])
findings.suggestion: Shared notFound() template partial in src/lib, plus a helper for the 404-shaped catch block

findings.issue: Debounced refresh uses a manual request counter; in-flight stale fetches are never cancelled
findings.suggestion: AbortController per refresh (controller.abort() on new keystroke) — platform primitive, cancels wasted work

findings.issue: vite in dependencies with empty devDependencies; a prod-only install pulls the build tool
findings.suggestion: Move vite to devDependencies; the harness installs before build/start so behavior is unchanged

findings.issue: apiUrl() hand-rolls pathname/query splitting and slash normalization
findings.suggestion: Build URLs with new URL(path, base) and let the URL API own parsing

findings.issue: 500-error fallback returns empty props, rendering 'No Pokémon found' UI with a 500 status — error state and empty state are conflated
findings.suggestion: Render a distinct error message in the fallback branch

summary: This code is on the framework's current stable release (0.11.0) and uses its current API shapes throughout, verified against gracile.js.org and the official starter templates; the dependency set is minimal, current-major, and free of redundancy. Platform usage is strong, with only minor misses (no AbortController, hand-rolled URL parsing). The main aging risk is mechanical: a duplicated build-time guard tied to a private env contract, five copies of the not-found fallback, an untyped handler→template boundary, and one stylesheet link that depends on undocumented build-time behavior.
